about.title: About BlueLux Pools
text: Welcome to BlueLux Pools, where your season of fun begins! We are a family-owned company offering quality fiberglass and gunite pool installations across the South. Contact us today to get started on the pool you’ve always wanted.
Our mission is to help families create lasting memories by building high-quality pools with integrity, care, and exceptional craftsmanship.
Our vision is to make luxury pool ownership accessible to every family – creating spaces that spark joy, strengthen connection, and add lasting value to both homes and lives.
